meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars 等常驻内核引擎分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据,先探测文件大小和内存再决定计算在哪运行,回答后报告行数与耗时,并按需画图。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet 或 JSON 数据,或做分组聚合、时间序列等任务时触发。

say.text: 分析一下 data.csv,按城市统计订单总额
say.note: 用 DuckDB 直接查询该文件

say.text: 这个 parquet 文件多大?先看行数和内存占用
say.note: 先探测再决定计算方式

say.text: 把月度销售趋势画成折线图
say.note: 触发绘图并按可视化规范做检查

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes CSV/Parquet/JSON data with resident engines like DuckDB and Polars, probes file size and RAM before deciding where computation runs, then reports the answer with row counts and timing, charting on request.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze CSV, Parquet, or JSON data, or perform group-by/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv and total order amounts by city
say_en.note: Queries the file directly with DuckDB

say_en.text: How big is this parquet file? Show row count and memory
Plot monthly sales as a line chart
say_en.note: Runs charting with the visual QA step
